title: Volume bound for a Hamming ball on the root cube
statement:
Let $K$ be a finite field, let $\omega \in K$, and let $n, e \in \bbn$. Write $\{1,\omega\}^n$ for the root cube of vectors $x : \{0,\dots,n-1\} \to K$ each of whose coordinates equals $1$ or $\omega$, and consider functions $f : \{1,\omega\}^n \to K$, the Hamming distance between two such functions being the number of points of the cube on which they differ. For any function $\mathrm{center} : \{1,\omega\}^n \to K$, the number of functions whose Hamming distance from $\mathrm{center}$ is at most $e$ satisfies
\[
\abs{\{\, f : \{1,\omega\}^n \to K \;\mid\; f \text{ differs from } \mathrm{center} \text{ on at most } e \text{ points}\,\}}
  \;\le\; \sum_{t=0}^{e} \binom{\,\abs{\{1,\omega\}^n}\,}{t}\,\abs{K}^{\,t},
\]
where $\abs{\{1,\omega\}^n}$ is the number of points of the cube and $\abs{K}$ is the number of elements of $K$.
hypotheses_covered: ω is an element of K
e is a natural number (the ball radius)
center is a function from the root cube to K
